{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment <= 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion after sharp spikes.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to avoid premature overshoots.",
    "Apply upward correction if true outcome exceeds forecast by >15% and sentiment is neutral, indicating potential market overreaction.",
    "Smooth out forecast volatility when sentiment is low (e.g., < 0.25) to avoid erratic price swings.",
    "If forecast consistently underestimates true outcome in 3+ consecutive days, increase baseline by 3-5% to offset persistent bias.",
    "When sentiment is positive and forecast is below historical 30-day mean, consider a 2-3% upward adjustment to align with bullish momentum."
  ]
}
